f1-builder-intro
Feature one: the Builder. Build a working app, just by describing it.
f1-builder-s1
Start in the Builder. Describe your app in plain English, like a habit tracker with streaks.
f1-builder-s2
With Plan first on, Buildify drafts a plan and asks a few quick questions before it writes any code.
f1-builder-s3
Click build. The agent writes the components, runs the build and checks that it passes, while you watch every step.
f1-builder-s4
Then click through a live preview of your working app.
f1-builder-outro
Next up: refine your app and export the code.
f2-refine-export-intro
Feature two: refine and export. Change your app just by chatting.
f2-refine-export-s1
Want a change? Type it in the chat, the way you'd ask a teammate. Add dark mode.
f2-refine-export-s2
Buildify edits only the files it needs, rebuilds, and saves version two.
f2-refine-export-s3
Switch the theme in the preview, and the whole app goes dark.
f2-refine-export-s4
Happy with it? Open Export. Push the code to your GitHub, or download it as a zip.
f2-refine-export-outro
Next up: design and publish a website in Buildify Studio.
f3-studio-intro
Feature three: Buildify Studio. Design and publish a website, visually.
f3-studio-s1
Studio is a visual editor for websites and portfolios. Start by picking a template.
f3-studio-s2
Drag in any element, like a button, and drop it on the canvas.
f3-studio-s3
Then position it exactly from the properties panel on the right.
f3-studio-s4
Click any text to edit it, and fine-tune the size and color.
f3-studio-s5
Hit preview to see your page on desktop, tablet and mobile.
f3-studio-s6
Click publish, give it a title and a short link, and it's live, ready to share.
f3-studio-outro
Next up: AI Chat, your on-demand coding assistant.
f4-ai-chat-intro
Feature four: AI Chat. Your on-demand coding assistant.
f4-ai-chat-s1
Open AI Chat from AI Tools in the sidebar.
f4-ai-chat-s2
Pick a model and ask for what you need, like a pomodoro timer.
f4-ai-chat-s3
The answer streams in: complete, working code, with focus and break modes and a progress ring.
f4-ai-chat-s4
Plus a clear breakdown of every feature. Share the whole transcript in one click.
f4-ai-chat-outro
Next up: test your site with the Accessibility Tester.
f5-accessibility-intro
Feature five: the Accessibility Tester. Check your site before you launch.
f5-accessibility-s1
Enter your website's URL, and choose the WCAG standards you care about.
f5-accessibility-s2
Start the test. Buildify crawls the site and streams live logs as it goes.
f5-accessibility-s3
You get an overall score, and a breakdown of issues by severity.
f5-accessibility-s4
Plus page by page results, and a PDF report you can share with your team.
f5-accessibility-outro
Next up: ready-made AI agents for your business.
f6-agents-intro
Feature six: AI agents. Ready-made bots for your business.
f6-agents-s1
Open Agents in the sidebar to browse ready-made AI bots, like FAQ, lead capture and customer service.
f6-agents-s2
The App Spec Builder interviews visitors about their app idea, and turns it into a build-ready spec.
f6-agents-s3
Deploy it on your website or in Telegram, and every captured spec shows up right here.
f6-agents-outro
That's Buildify. Build, test and launch, all with AI. Start free at buildify dot s h.
